BP0001.name: la_voltage_not_set
BP0001.message: The I/O voltage is not set
BP0001.cause: The pod starts with its I/O voltage unset and never picks one on its own, so it cannot drive a board at a voltage the board does not take. Anything that uses the LA pins (UART, flashing, captures, GPIO, I2C, SPI, sensor emulation) needs it first.

fix.sdk: set the board's I/O voltage first: BenchPod(conn, la_voltage=3.3) (1.8 for a 1.8 V board), the benchpod_la_voltage fixture in conftest.py, or bp.set_la_voltage(3.3)
fix.cli: set the board's I/O voltage first: `benchpod la voltage 3.3V` (or 1.8V)
fix.mcp: call set_la_voltage with the board's I/O voltage (1.8 or 3.3) first
fix.web: Set the board's I/O voltage (1.8 V or 3.3 V) in the Pins pane first.

BP0002.name: unknown_command
BP0002.message: The pod does not know the command {cmd}
BP0002.cause: The firmware on the pod is older than the tool that sent the command, or the command name is wrong. Newer SDK, CLI and MCP versions check the pod's capabilities first and say which firmware a feature needs.

fix.sdk: update the pod's firmware (`benchpod flash-self`, or the firmware update in the web app)
fix.cli: update the pod's firmware with `benchpod flash-self`
fix.mcp: tell the user the pod's firmware is too old for this; they can update it with `benchpod flash-self` or in the web app
fix.web: Update the pod's firmware on its Settings tab.

BP0003.name: i2c_session_open
BP0003.message: An I2C session is already open
BP0003.cause: The pod runs one I2C master session at a time.

fix.sdk: close the open session first (its close(), or leave its with block)
fix.cli: end the other I2C command first
fix.web: Close the open I2C session first.

BP0004.name: spi_session_open
BP0004.message: An SPI session is already open
BP0004.cause: The pod runs one SPI master session at a time.

fix.sdk: close the open session first (its close(), or leave its with block)
fix.cli: end the other SPI command first
fix.mcp: wait for the other SPI call to finish, then try again
fix.web: Close the open SPI session first.

BP0005.name: bus_engine_busy
BP0005.message: The engine that runs SWD, SPI and I2C is in use, so {want} cannot start
BP0005.cause: Flashing (SWD), the SPI master and the I2C master share one engine on the pod. While one of them runs, the other two wait.

fix.sdk: wait for the running flash, SPI or I2C session to finish (close it), then try again
fix.cli: wait for the running flash, SPI or I2C command to finish, then try again
fix.mcp: wait for the running flash, spi or i2c call to finish (i2c_close for an open I2C session), then try again
fix.web: Wait for the running flash, SPI or I2C session to finish.
